$comment: Machine-readable support matrix. install.sh and the README both read this list, so adding an agent means editing one place.

install_methods.name: install.sh
install_methods.description: Copy into any agent's project or user-level skills directory.

install_methods.name: Kilo / Roo remote catalog
install_methods.description: This collection's dist/index.json uses the {name, version, files[]} shape that Kilo Code's skills.urls consumes today. Entry files are fetched from <base><name>/<file>.

install_methods.name: Cloudflare discovery draft v0.2.0
install_methods.description: The draft well-known convention expects /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json with {name, type, url, digest} entries and sha256 digests over raw bytes. Not ratified, and adoption is negligible.

install_methods.name: Claude Code plugin
install_methods.description: Add the repository as a plugin marketplace.

install_methods.name: skills.sh registry
install_methods.description: Groupings for the skills.sh repository page, via skills.sh.json.

install_methods.name: skills-ref
install_methods.description: Validate against the open specification with the reference CLI.

mcp_note.discovery: skills/list and skills/get JSON-RPC methods, not a file
mcp_note.caveat: There is no skill://index.json in the final specification; an earlier draft proposed one and it was removed. No official SDK has merged support yet, so this collection does not claim MCP compatibility. Serving dist/index.json is a filesystem-style catalog for agents that fetch one.

agents.label: OpenCode
agents.notes: Discovers .claude/skills and .agents/skills automatically as compatibility roots.

agents.label: Claude Code
agents.notes: Also installable as a plugin from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.

agents.label: Agent Skills spec clients (VS Code Copilot, Codex, and others)
GitHub Copilot
agents.notes: Also served as agent instructions and custom instructions in the same ecosystem.

agents.label: Any agent supporting an HTTP catalog
agents.notes: Build with scripts/build-catalog.sh and serve dist/ from any static host.
